sys_script_client.name: Auto set urgency for high impact
sys_script_client.description: Automatically set Urgency to 1 (High) and display info message when Impact is set to 1 (High).

sys_script_client.name: Prevent save if Assigned To missing
sys_script_client.description: Validates that Assigned To is populated when Impact is 1 (High). Shows field error and aborts submission if missing.

sys_script_client.name: Prevent state change via list edit
sys_script_client.description: Prevents inline cell editing of the State field in incident list view with an alert message.

test_1_mandatory_enforcement.details: Impact=1 triggers onChange banner, locks Urgency to 1 (High, disabled), sets Assignment Group mandatory. Submitting with empty Assigned To is blocked with error: 'Assigned To is mandatory for High impact incidents.'

test_2_successful_save.details: Populated Assigned To (David Loo) with Impact=1. Incident saved successfully. Priority calculated to 1 - Critical.

test_3_reverse_condition.details: Changing Impact from 1 to 2 reversed UI Policy: Urgency unlocked to editable, Assignment Group mandatory reverted to false.

test_4_list_edit_rejection.details: Double-clicking State column in list view triggered alert and cancelled edit callback(false).

test_5_form_update.details: Updating State directly inside record form view succeeded normally.
